questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13- Operations on 13 such as adding /Subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(9, 3, 30)

(10, 3, 33)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number number + 1) × Second number = Third number

 
• (9, 3, 30) → (9 + 1) × 3 = 10 × 3 = 30
 
• (10, 3, 33) → (10 + 1) × 3 = 11 × 3 = 33

Similarly,

 
• (12, 3, 39) → (12 + 1) × 3 = 13 × 3 = 39

Hence, '**(12, 3, 39)**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /Subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(12, 8, 80)

(16, 10, 131)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number)² - (Second number ÷ 2)3 = Third number

 
• (12, 8, 80) → 12² - (8 ÷ 2)³ = 144 - 4³ = 144 - 64 = 80
 
• (16, 10, 131) → 162 - (10 ÷ 2)3 = 256 - 53 = 256 - 125 = 131

Similarly,

 
• (9, 6, 54) → 92 - (6 ÷ 2)3 = 81 - 33 = 81 - 27 = 54

Hence, '**(9, 6, 54)**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Anklet : Ankle :: Bracelet : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First one is wore on the second one.

 
• Anklet : Ankle → An anklet is wore on ankle.

Similarly,

 
• Bracelet → A bracelet is wore on wrist.

Hence, '**Wrist**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number. 

864 ∶ 12 ∶∶ 1372 ∶ 14 ∶∶ 2048 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **First number = (Second number)² × (Second number ÷ 2)

 
• 864 ∶ 12 → 12² × (12 ÷ 2) = 144 × 6 = 864
 
• 1372 ∶ 14 → 142 × (14 ÷ 2) = 196 × 7 = 1372

Similarly,

 
• 2048 ∶ ? → 162 × (16 ÷ 2) = 256 × 8 = 2048

Hence, '**16**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 8, 28, 53

Second row - 7, 25, 47

Third row - 13, 43, ?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number × 3 + 1) + Second number = Third number

__
 
• First row - 8, 28, 53 → (8 × 3 + 1) + 28 = (24 + 1) + 28 = 25 + 28 = 53
 
• Second row - 7, 25, 47 → (7 × 3 + 1) + 25 = (21 + 1) + 25 = 22 + 25 = 47

Similarly,

 
• Third row - 13, 43, ? → (13 × 3 + 1) + 43 = (39 + 1) + 43 = 40 + 43 = 83

Hence, '**83**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

L T K _ H L _ _ J H _ V _ J H L _ K _ H

options.text: J U K L K W J
I U K L K W J
I U K M K W J
J U K L K X J

questions.solution:
• J U K L K W J → L T K **J** H / L **U K** J H / **L** V **K** J H / L **W** K **J** H
 
• I U K L K W J → L T K **I** H / L **U K** J H / **L** V **K** J H / L **W** K **J** H
 
• I U K M K W J → L T K **I** H / L **U K** J H / **M** V **K** J H / L **W** K **J** H
 
• J U K L K X J → L T K **J** H / L **U K** J H / **L** V **K** J H / L **X** K **J** H

 
• In option 1, a pattern is being repeated. 

 
 
• First and last three letters are same when the sequence is divided into four equal parts.
 
• Second letter follows the pattern: T + 1 = U; U + 1 = V; V + 1 = W
 
 

Hence, ‘**J U K L K W J**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If '+' means 'subtraction', '-' means 'multiplication', '÷' means 'addition' and '×' means 'division', then what is the value of the following expression?

11 - 14 + 9 × 3 ÷ 104
questions.solution:
**Symbols**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
×

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

11 - 14 + 9 × 3 ÷ 104

After replacing the symbols by their meaning, we get:

__**11 × 14**__ - __**9 ÷ 3**__ + 104

= __**154**__ - 3 __**+ 104**__

= __**258 - 3**__

= 255

Hence, ‘**255**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All balls are flowers.

All flowers are plates.

Some plates are cups.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some flowers are balls.

II. Some plates are flowers.

III. All cups are plates.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74125932d14ae840ae593127e2c3de6a8666523e4a71667baa8f7a87f49a58d3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flowers are balls. → **Follows** (As, All balls are flowers)

II. Some plates are flowers. → Follows (As, All flowers are plates)

III. All cups are plates. → Does not follow (As, Some plates are cups → Some cups are plates)

Hence, '**Only conclusions I and II follow**' is the correct answer.
